nav-tool: Navigation link to the Data Weaver tool itself.
nav-howto: Navigation link to the usage guide.
nav-about: Navigation link to the About section.
tab-about: Tab label: overview of the project.
tab-story: Tab label: the story behind the tool and typical workflows.
tab-community: Tab label: community and contribution page.
settings: Tooltip of the gear button that opens the settings dialog.
login: Button: log in with a Wikimedia account.
foot-built-pre: Start of the footer sentence. Followed by the author's name, then a list of organisations.
loginbar-text: Banner shown above the tool when the user is not logged in.
login-required-title: Dialog title shown when the user tries to save without being logged in.
login-required-text: Dialog text explaining that saving needs a Wikimedia account.
login-required-note: Dialog note: the login opens in a new tab so no work is lost.
settings-language-help: Help text under the language drop-down.
settings-typing: Heading of the typing-tools section (input methods for writing in other scripts).
settings-typing-help: Help text under the checkbox. jQuery IME and Universal Language Selector are product names.
settings-typing-language: Label: the language you want to type in.
settings-typing-method: Label: the keyboard layout or transliteration scheme.
settings-typing-try: Placeholder of a text box where the user can test the selected input method.
settings-typing-loading: Status text while input methods are loading.
settings-typing-ready: Status text. $1 is the number of languages that have input methods.
settings-privacy: Heading of the section with settings that send data to other services.
settings-osm: Checkbox label. OpenStreetMap and Nominatim are product names.
settings-osm-help: Privacy explanation under the OpenStreetMap checkbox.
settings-local-note: Note: settings are saved in the browser, not on the server.
@app: Source-text translations for the tool's own interface. Each key is the exact English text shown in the tool, each value its translation. Only static labels match; text with counters or file names is left as is.
typing-on: Short hint shown when Ctrl+M switches the typing tool on. $1 is the input method name.
typing-off: Short hint shown when Ctrl+M switches back to the system keyboard.
typing-not-set: Short hint shown when Ctrl+M is pressed but no typing tool is configured.
